To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the synthesis of [1,6]dioxaspiro [5.5]-nonane 5 from the steroidal aglycone hecogenin was accomplished and that this simplified analogue of the right-side unit in cephalostatin 3 (3) was found to be inactive against the P388 cancer cell line.

the synthesis of a simplified steroidal unit of cephalostatin 3, a 1,6-dioxaspiro-[5.5] nonane analogue, has been achieved in seven steps from the natural product hecogenin with an overall yield 4.6%.
the synthesis of [6.5]spirononane 5 from hecogenins was achieved and that 5 was found to have no cancer cell growth inhibiting activity against the P-388 lymphocytic leukemic cell line.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of a simplified analogue of the right-side steroidal component of cephalostatin 2 (1) and the determination of its antitumor activity.
the synthesis of cephalostatin analogues with the goal of identifying new, less complex analogues that are active as cancer cell growth inhibitors.
the synthesis of a simplified analogue of cephalostatin 12, which is a potent inhibitor of cancer cell growth, and its evaluation as an anticancer agent.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a simplified structural modification of the right-side steroidal portion of 1, which is a critical component of the overall structure of this potent cancer cell growth inhibiting alkaloid, is not tolerated.
a simplified right-side unit of 1 has lost the biological activity, whereas the left side of 1 is responsible for the activity.
a simplified steroidal pyrazine analogue of 1, with the right-side spiroketal moiety replaced with a [5.5]-spiroketal, is inactive as a cancer cell growth inhibitor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Cephalostatans are a family of structurally complex and biologically potent steroidal alkaloids.
a reduction in structural complexity in the right side of the molecule is associated with a reduction in biological activity.
the Cephalostatins are not simply a collection of structurally complex natural products, but also a collection of structural modifications of a single parent structure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 1,6-dioxaspiroketal unit in 1 may be important for the observed biological activity.
a spiroketal ring system can be incorporated into a simplified analogue of 1, and this may be useful for future SAR studies of the cephalostatin family of compounds.
the [5.5]-spiroketal unit of 1 is essential for activity.
